summary: Remote-driven PTY shell exposed via relay WebSocket in @agent-link/agent
details: When the installed `agentlink-client start` command runs, dist/service.js and related modules open a WebSocket connection to a relay server (default `msclaude.ai`, overridable to a user-configured host) and spawn a local pseudo-terminal via `pty.spawn(process.env.SHELL || '/bin/bash')` (or `powershell.exe` on Windows). Incoming WebSocket messages of type `terminal_input` are forwarded verbatim into that PTY via `terminalManager.write(msg.data)`, giving any party able to send messages on the relay session the ability to execute arbitrary commands in the operator's shell. A separate `tunnel_request` / `tunnel_ws_open` handler in dist/tunnel.js proxies relay messages to `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` and `ws://127.0.0.1:<port>` on the installer's host, gated by a user-maintained allowlist in `~/.agentlink/tools/proxy-config.json` (default disabled with an empty allowlist). dist/service.js also modifies the shell PATH to include `~/.local/bin`, `~/.npm-global/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, and `/usr/bin` for the spawned shell. The relay-driven PTY provides full-host code execution on the operator's machine while the tool is running; end-to-end encryption and an optional password gate the channel but do not remove the remote-execution trust boundary the relay operator holds.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
